title: Feature: a dash with a cooldown
prompt: Add a dash. Pressing Space makes the player move three times as fast for 0.2 seconds in the direction they are moving; after that the dash cannot be used again for 1 second. Name the new simulation button `Dash`.
notes: Rules, input binding and state. Graded by a hidden scenario: a dash covers distance, a second press during the cooldown does not, a press after it does.

solutionEdits.old: enum class ArenaButton { Left, Right, Up, Down };
solutionEdits.new: enum class ArenaButton { Left, Right, Up, Down, Dash };

bindings.Bind(0, ArenaButton::Down, InputKey::Down);
    bindings.Bind(0, ArenaButton::Dash, InputKey::Space);
